_meta: EXTRA OBSERVED BATCH 2. Real observed chat, saw_tcg / ScythersTCG, Whatnot, 2026-09-12, same show as triage_test.jsonl but a later, separate segment. Reconstructed from 104 screen frames sampled at 15s, deduped against each frame's tail. Frames 6, 11, 30, 34, 35, 57, 59, 78, 79, 85 and 87 were byte-identical to their predecessor: zero messages in that interval. `highlighted` records whether Whatnot's own UI marked the message orange. `mod` is the explicit Mod badge beside the username, NOT the orange level crown on the avatar (that is the Bronze/Silver tier badge, cf. the 'Unlocked Bronze' system events). Labels follow the Intent enum in app/models.py. See docs/research/chat-analysis-2026-09-12.md.
